sources.supports: each state's patron-saint day, listed separately from the statutory public holidays, as a school-free day (read directly)

public_holidays: No state-only statutory public holidays: Austria's public holidays are national and are on Austria's record.
culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.

laws.rule: Styria's overnight levy (Nächtigungsabgabe) is set by state ordinance LGBl. 75/2026 for stays from 1 December 2026: EUR 1.70 per person per night in alpine huts and shelters, EUR 2.20 on camping, caravan, motorhome and mobile-home pitches, and EUR 2.80 in all other accommodation (about A$2.70, A$3.50 and A$4.45 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026), section 1(1). The earlier ordinance amounts apply until then.
laws.heading: Festsetzung der Nächtigungsabgabe, LGBl. 75/2026, section 1
